text.description_html:
Acorn RI9BQ, Heart Tip Cabinet Strap Rough Iron Hinge

The 6-1/2" Rough Iron Strap Hinge is suitable for light weight doors or cabinets. Its old world charm is in both the heart tip design and in the rough iron finish which duplicates the texture of naturally weathered iron. Available in both a flush and an offset variety. The Rough Iron Cabinet Heart Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty. Click Here to see the entire Acorn Heart Tip Collection.

Also Available: Flush 6-1/2" Smooth Iron Cabinet Strap Hinges and 6-1/2" Smooth Iron Cabinet Strap Hinges

Features for the Acorn Heart Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the 6-1/2" Heart Tip Offset Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 6-1/2"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • For doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
